# Merriam-Webster

> > America's most trusted dictionary and language resource, providing comprehensive word definitions, etymology, pronunciation guides, and vocabulary-building tools.

Merriam-Webster offers multiple dictionary products including the free online dictionary with 300,000+ definitions, the premium Unabridged edition with 700,000+ entries, and the authoritative Collegiate Dictionary. The site features word games (Quordle, Blossom, Scrabble tools), educational resources for students, slang dictionaries, and daily vocabulary features including Word of the Day.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary definitions and etymology
- Word of the Day
- Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary
- Unabridged Dictionary (premium)
- Scrabble and word game solvers
- Vocabulary building and test prep
- Quordle and Blossom word games
- Slang and modern language
- Greek and Latin word roots
- Educational resources for kids
- Mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- Language learning tools
- Pronunciation guides
- Etymology and word history

## Dictionary Resources

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Homepage with 300,000+ word definitions, games, and language resources
- [The Unabridged Dictionary by Merriam-Webster](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/): Comprehensive dictionary with 700,000+ definitions, premium subscription
- [Slang Dictionary - Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Modern slang, trending phrases, Gen Z terms, and emoji definitions
- [Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, Twelfth Edition](https://www.merriam-webster.com/collegiate-dictionary-twelfth-edition): Product page for Collegiate Dictionary Twelfth Edition reference book

## Vocabulary & Learning

- [Word of the Day Calendar](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/calendar): Daily vocabulary feature with podcast, email, and social media delivery
- [Student Dictionary for Kids](https://www.merriam-webster.com/kids): Educational dictionary and vocabulary games designed for young students
- [The Merriam-Webster Vocabulary Builder](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/products/the-merriam-webster-vocabulary-builder): Test prep book with Greek/Latin roots for SAT, ACT, and TOEFL students

## Word Games & Tools

- [Word Finder: Scrabble & Word Game Solver](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Scrabble solver and word game tool for finding valid dictionary words
- [Dictionary and Word Game Apps](https://www.merriam-webster.com/apps): Mobile apps for dictionary, Scrabble, and word games on iOS/Android

## Support & Information

- [About the Unabridged](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/info/about-the-unabridged.html): Information about Unabridged dictionary features and search capabilities

## Optional

- [Merch – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/merch): Language-themed merchandise including tote bags and accessories
